For finite totally imaginary Galois M/Q, Ind_(complex conjugation)^Gal(M/Q)(sign) embeds in the additive ell-adic character space, which embeds in the regular representation; the action is faithful.

For all but finitely many split degree-one target primes of Q(i), the union of active source partners over eligible ell is finite.
The simultaneous power-residue separation assertion holds for the displayed prime lists, bounds and congruence condition, including overlapping lists.
Almost every target prime of Q(i) over a split rational prime has an active source partner with the same rational residue characteristic.
